title: Replay Is a Family of Assertions: Fork-Safety in Event-Sourced Agent Runtimes
abstract: arXiv:2611.06924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event-sourced agent runtimes commonly claim deterministic replay, cheap forking, and lineage. These are families of assertions, not one guarantee. A fixed-log fold may be deterministic while reactive settlement remains schedule-sensitive; a recorded oracle result can enable zero-call replay while the original interaction still changed cost or world state; and a prefix copy cannot undo an action in a discarded suffix.   We present an executable F# contract that separates facts from effect requests, makes scheduling explicit, and assesses a cut relative to projection, strict execution replay, external continuation, or a declared counterfactual-world observation. Preserved counterexamples show that general settlement is neither terminating nor confluent and that disjoint declared writes do not prevent read/trigger interference. translated_title: 重放是一族断言：事件溯源式智能体运行时中的分叉安全性
translated_abstract: 事件溯源式智能体运行时通常声称具备确定性重放、低成本分叉和谱系追踪能力，但这些实际上是一族断言，而非单一保证。固定的日志折叠可能是确定性的，而响应式结算仍然对调度顺序敏感；记录下来的预言机结果可以实现零调用重放，而原始交互却已经改变了成本或世界状态；前缀副本无法撤销被丢弃后缀中的动作。我们提出了一个可执行的 F# 契约，它将事实与效果请求分离，使调度显式化，并相对于投影、严格执行重放、外部延续或声明的反事实世界观察来评估截断。保留的反例表明，一般性结算既不具终止性也不具合流性，且互不相交的声明写入并不能防止读/触发干扰。在 5,540 个公开运行时日志的实验中，全部 317,296 个投影截断均满足所述观察，而 36,251 个截断……
tldr: 本文提出一个将事实与效果请求分离、使调度显式化的可执行 F# 契约，证明事件溯源式智能体运行时中的确定性重放、低成本分叉与谱系是三个相互独立的断言而非单一保证，并通过反例与大规模日志验证揭示了一般性结算既不终止也不合流。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an executable F# contract that separates facts from effect requests and makes scheduling explicit, demonstrating that deterministic replay, cheap forking, and lineage in event-sourced agent runtimes are a family of distinct assertions rather than a single guarantee, with counterexamples showing general settlement is neither terminating nor confluent.
